title: Spicy Smoked Nourishing Noodle Soup
description: A nourishing and flavorful Thai-inspired noodle soup that combines smoky flavors with a hint of spicy horseradish. A comforting meal for any time of the day.
instructions: Heat the nourishing broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the Thai Red Curry Paste and stir to combine.
Add the diced smoked tofu and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the rice noodles and cook according to package instructions.
Stir in the Kanom Jeen Sauce and adjust seasoning as needed.
Taste and adjust the horseradish level to desired spiciness.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and lime wedges.
Enjoy with your favorite Thai-inspired dishes.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat as needed, adding more broth if necessary.
